Vault is in dev mode — no unsealing needed. Exec in: kubectl exec -it vault-client -n dojo-sec-vault -- sh. The VAULT_ADDR and VAULT_TOKEN env vars are pre-set.
First check Vault is up: vault status (should show Sealed: false). Then write the secret: vault kv put secret/dojo/challenge flag=KUBE{vault_dynamic_ttl_beats_static_secrets}
Read the flag back: vault kv get -field=flag secret/dojo/challenge — the -field flag extracts just the value without the metadata table
